Elena — appreciate the clear asks. I pulled together a compact MAP and action card to make the sprint run in parallel with contract review. High-level approach below; I attached a one-page MAP (Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf) and put our suggested sprint dates and owners in the PDF.

Summary (short):
1) SOC 2: Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months, plus an interim controls snapshot and evidence packages for the last 90 days. Suggested acceptance criteria: review of SOC2 report + three control artifacts (access reviews, change management runbook, incident response table). Target: evidence handoff by Dec 22, review complete by Jan 10.

2) SIG/CAIQ: We completed a full CAIQ baseline; GoldenBank priority questions in your spreadsheet are highlighted. We propose a 2-week iterate-and-respond sprint where we:
   - Day 1: Redwood posts responses to 60% of questions (templates for technical controls)
   - Day 5: joint review on outstanding/custom controls
   - Day 10–14: followup responses and evidence links
Owners: Kimberly (Redwood) for CAIQ answers, Elena + GoldenBank security for validation.

3) DPA + Data residency/retention: Draft DPA language is ready; we will add a short annex for EU residency and retention buckets (30/90/365 days) per your ask. Proposed timeline: initial DPA draft (Dec 17), legal redline (Dec 20–23), final mutual signoff (target Dec 29). Note: if your legal team needs a longer review, we can push production vesting to Jan 15 to preserve Q1 target.

4) Logging & evidence: We can provide:
   - System audit log export process (S3 archive with access controls)
   - Sample retention windows for event logs and user activity (30/180/365 options)
   - A temporary elevated evidence view for auditors (timeboxed)
Acceptance: short walkthrough + sample export delivered by Jan 5.

Action items (what we need from GoldenBank):
- Elena: confirm which retention bucket applies to GoldenBank (30/90/365) for PII-labeled transcripts by EOD Dec 16
- GoldenBank security: prioritize top 12 SIG questions from the spreadsheet and flag any custom controls by Dec 16
- Procurement: share procurement timeline so we can align DocuSign window

I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk the MAP and owners through it. If that works, Kimberly will own CAIQ responses and Marissa will be the E2E evidence coordinator.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Elena — looping in a few clarification points from Engineering & Legal so the MAP can be executable on our side:

1) Data residency: for EU-resident accounts we propose EU-region tenancy plus an EU-only backup / archival path. Can you confirm whether GoldenBank requires strict EU-only processing (no dual-write to US regions)? If strict, we will prepare an annex to the DPA to reflect that and prepare a deployment change request.

2) Retention categories: Redwood supports three retention tiers for customer content (30 / 90 / 365 days). We need a customer-decision for transcripts vs. logs. If GoldenBank chooses 365 for transcripts, engineering will require an ops acceptance slot in the Jan 8–12 maintenance window.

3) SIG exceptions: a couple of GoldenBank items marked as custom controls may need compensating controls rather than changes to Redwood code. We'll document compensating controls in the MAP and mark them as acceptance artifacts.

Quick asks from Legal (cc'd):
- Please confirm your preferred DPA signature authority and whether you require a pre-signed NDA-exhibit for SOC artifacts.

Next steps:
- Jonas to run the 30-min MAP review (scheduled: Wed Dec 15 13:00 PST)
- GoldenBank to return prioritized SIG questions and retention selection by EOD Dec 16
- Redwood to publish CAIQ answers v1 and DPA draft by Dec 17

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Architect, Redwood Inference
